verdict.rationale: The evidence implies repository connection: Devin indexes your repositories, can reach internal Git hosts over VPN, and its MCP tools can query private GitHub repos with authentication. Review Auto-Fix responding to code review comments and CI failures implies a PR workflow. However, no item explicitly documents connecting GitHub or Devin opening pull requests. Missing for 10: explicit GitHub integration/connection docs, explicit evidence of Devin opening PRs, independent hands-on corroboration.
